verdict.rationale: JumpCloud is a SaaS directory and identity platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. Its REST APIs and PowerShell module are developer building blocks, and the mention of managing 'agent' identities is a different feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
